__note: Keys are written only to the local science/config.json. Fields marked "saved, not yet read by tools" do not take effect in this version.

core.hint: Open access full-text aggregation; the key must be requested in the CORE console.

crossref.hint: Shares the same email field as OpenAlex.

europepmc.hint: Public REST; no credentials required. Searches with SRC:PPR return only preprints (bioRxiv / medRxiv / PsyArXiv / Research Square).

openalex.hint: Just enter an email to join the polite pool; the same email is also used for Crossref.

pubmed.hint: Without a key, limited to 3 req/s. Two-step retrieval (esearch → esummary); filter preprints by publication type.

semantic-scholar.hint: The free key quota is not high, but it can significantly raise the rate limit.

unpaywall.hint: Only requires an email; used to look up legal open access versions.

zotero.hint: Library sync; read-only permission is enough.
